title: Authority-Chain Continuity vs Consequence-Specific Scope Sufficiency
architectural_boundary: Frozen R0 -> current R0-to-B authority -> current B-to-C delegation instrument -> current effective delegated scope -> unchanged C authority instrument -> Specialty Pack scope admission -> constituted domain state -> Harmonic determination
frozen_proposition: A currently intact authority chain does not imply standing for every proposition or consequence inside that chain.
distinction: Authority-chain continuity is not equivalent to consequence-specific scope sufficiency.
hard_rule: No child authority may inherit broader standing than the currently effective scope of the authority empowering it.
derivation_rule: No precomputed scope-insufficient flag or case-specific constitutional answer may be supplied. The Pack must derive scope sufficiency from the current delegation scope and the exact Scope S / Consequence K.

pair.case_a: R0 -> B -> C remains current and valid; the effective B-to-C delegation includes proposition execution_region_for_shared_execution, Scope S, and Consequence K.
pair.case_b: The same R0 -> B -> C authority chain remains current and valid, but the current effective B-to-C scope narrows so that C no longer carries Scope S or Consequence K while remaining authorized for other scope/consequence combinations.

pass: For the affected consequence, the Pack stops constituting C as governing while preserving C authority for unaffected scopes/consequences.
fail: The Pack treats intact authority-chain continuity as sufficient and allows Consequence K or Scope S to inherit authority outside the currently effective B-to-C scope.
unresolved: The architecture cannot represent consequence-specific or sub-scope standing independently from overall authority-chain continuity, or the frozen pair cannot execute without changing another substantive dimension.
falsifier: Can an authority chain remain intact globally while standing fractures locally for an exact consequence or sub-scope — and does the Pack derive that fracture from current delegation evidence?
secondary_harmonic_witness: Harmonic exact replay is downstream witness evidence only. RED TEAM 005 passes or fails first at the Specialty Pack scope-admission boundary; Harmonic cannot rescue an incorrect Pack constitution.
claim_ceiling: A future PASS is bounded to the represented R0-to-B authority, B-to-C delegation instrument, effective delegated-scope records, exact Scope S / Consequence K, and executable Pack reference. It does not establish external truth of authority evidence, universal scope closure, or downstream physical enforcement.
